Nora (CSM): Heads-up — Seabright dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:15 PT. Committed quota: 10 GPUs across pools sea-main/sea-aux. Target steady 4.5k qps, burst to 10k. Need autoscale, priming, and billing cap signoff.
Ben (SRE): I can run the test. Window 09:15–10:45 PT. Seed 15m, steady 40m @4500, then two bursts. Load cmd: `./infraloader --case seabright_main --qps 4500 --dur 2400`; burst: `--qps 10000 --dur 600`. Streaming to #eng-sre.
Tasha (SE): I'll seed KV and run a cold-start check. Command: `rbw-prime --pools=sea-main --concurrency=30 --duration=900` starting 15m before steady. I'll also kill one replica mid-burst to validate fallback.
Nora (CSM): @Ben @Tasha confirm we have 1.25x headroom for autoscale and fallback to `redwood-hosted/spot-fallback` if we hit max_replicas. Also request billing cap by EOD.
Ben (SRE): Autoscale proposal: min_replicas=1, target_util=0.7, max_replicas=16, scale_up_window=50s, scale_down_delay=420s. Fallback route configured as requested. Alerts: p95>300ms OR 5xx>0.7% => page.
Liam (PM): Product asks: capture p50/p95/p99 per-route + error rate; collect 5k sample outputs (steady+burst) for quick eval to check tokenization regressions.
Nora (CSM): I'll host a 14:30 PT enablement + renewal check after the run. If steady p95 <260ms and cost within 10% forecast mark renewal green.
ops-bot: scheduled_job seabright-warmup -> queued for 2026-08-10T16:15:00Z
Tasha (SE): Runbook snippet:
```
# seed
rbw-prime --pools sea-main,sea-aux --concurrency 30 --duration 900
# steady
./infraloader --case seabright_main --qps 4500 --dur 2400 --report ./reports/seabright_steady.json
# bursts
./infraloader --case seabright_burst --qps 8000 --dur 600
./infraloader --case seabright_burst --qps 10000 --dur 600
```
Ben (SRE): I'll post Grafana and load profiles in 10m. If tail latencies spike >350ms we throttle and rerun. Streaming logs to #eng-sre.
Nora (CSM): Action items:
- Ben: run window 09:15–10:45 PT, stream logs, abort if alerts fire
- Tasha: seed 15m prior; run kill/fallback during burst; attach 5k sample outputs
- Liam: prepare eval script by 08:30 PT
- Nora: host 14:30 PT enablement & capture feedback in CS tracker
Ben (SRE): noted. Ping me immediately if billing/keys fail. Thanks team — thread is canonical for the run.
